WITH pubs AS (
  SELECT
    "publication_number",
    "publication_date",
    "country_code",
    -- extract inventor count: count of elements in inventor VARIANT array if present and array, else 0
    CASE
      WHEN "inventor" IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN TYPEOF("inventor") = 'ARRAY' THEN ARRAY_SIZE("inventor")
      WHEN TYPEOF("inventor") = 'OBJECT' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS inventor_count
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
  WHERE "publication_date" IS NOT NULL
    AND "publication_date" BETWEEN 19600101 AND 20201231
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM pubs
  WHERE inventor_count >= 1
),
buckets AS (
  SELECT
    -- compute year from YYYYMMDD numeric
    FLOOR("publication_date" / 10000) AS pub_year,
    inventor_count,
    country_code
  FROM filtered
),
binned AS (
  SELECT
    -- compute 5-year bucket start year: 1960-1964 => 1960 etc.
    CASE
      WHEN pub_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 2020
      THEN 1960 + FLOOR((pub_year - 1960) / 5) * 5
    END AS bucket_start,
    inventor_count,
    country_code
  FROM buckets
  WHERE pub_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 2020
)
/* Aggregate per 5-year bucket */
SELECT
  bucket_start || '-' || (bucket_start + 4) AS five_year_period,
  -- average inventors per patent in bucket
  ROUND(AVG(inventor_count)::FLOAT, 2) AS avg_inventors_per_patent,
  -- total count of publications in Canada (country_code = 'CA')
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_code = 'CA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ca_publication_count,
  COUNT(*) AS total_publication_count
FROM binned
GROUP BY bucket_start
ORDER BY bucket_start

WITH a61_pubs AS (
  SELECT
    p."family_id",
    f.value:"assignee"::STRING AS assignee,
    p."publication_date",
    TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(p."publication_date"/1000), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS pub_dt,
    EXTRACT(year FROM TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(p."publication_date"/1000)) AS pub_year,
    p."country_code"
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS p,
       LATERAL FLATTEN(input => p."assignee") f
  WHERE ARRAY_SIZE( (p."cpc")) > 0
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM LATERAL FLATTEN(input => p."cpc") c
      WHERE c.value::STRING LIKE 'A61%' OR c.value:"code"::STRING LIKE 'A61%'
    )
    AND f.value:"assignee" IS NOT NULL
),
assignee_year_counts AS (
  SELECT
    assignee,
    pub_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT family_id) AS patents_in_year
  FROM a61_pubs
  GROUP BY assignee, pub_year
),
assignee_best_year AS (
  SELECT
    a.assignee,
    a.pub_year,
    a.patents_in_year,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assignee ORDER BY a.patents_in_year DESC, a.pub_year) AS rn
  FROM assignee_year_counts a
),
most_active_assignee AS (
  SELECT
    assignee,
    pub_year AS busiest_year
  FROM (
    SELECT
      assignee,
      busiest_year,
      patents_in_year,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY patents_in_year DESC, busiest_year) AS rn2
    FROM (
      SELECT
        m.assignee,
        m.pub_year AS busiest_year,
        m.patents_in_year
      FROM assignee_best_year m
      WHERE m.rn = 1
    )
  )
  WHERE rn2 = 1
),
jurisdiction_counts AS (
  SELECT
    a.assignee,
    a.busiest_year,
    p."country_code" AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p."family_id") AS patents_in_jurisdiction
  FROM most_active_assignee a
  JOIN a61_pubs p
    ON p.assignee = a.assignee
   AND p.pub_year = a.busiest_year
  GROUP BY a.assignee, a.busiest_year, p."country_code"
),
top5_jurisdictions AS (
  SELECT
    jurisdiction
  FROM jurisdiction_counts
  ORDER BY patents_in_jurisdiction DESC, jurisdiction
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT LISTAGG(jurisdiction, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY NULL) AS top_5_jurisdictions
FROM top5_jurisdictions

WITH cpc_apps AS (
  SELECT
    p."publication_number",
    p."application_number",
    p."family_id",
    p."country_code",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(p."publication_date"), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS pub_date_iso,
    CASE WHEN p."publication_date" IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(p."publication_date") END AS pub_date_raw,
    CASE WHEN p."publication_date" IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(p."publication_date"),1,4) AS INTEGER) END AS pub_year,
    a.value:"name"::STRING AS assignee_name
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS p,
       LATERAL FLATTEN(input => p."cpc") cpc -- p."cpc" may be null; flatten safe
       LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
         SELECT value
         FROM LATERAL FLATTEN(input => p."assignee") 
         WHERE TRUE
       ) a ON TRUE
  WHERE cpc.value:"symbol"::STRING LIKE 'A01B3%' 
    -- ensure assignee present
    AND p."assignee" IS NOT NULL
),
assignee_app_counts AS (
  SELECT
    assignee_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT application_number) AS total_applications
  FROM cpc_apps
  WHERE assignee_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY assignee_name
),
top3_assignees AS (
  SELECT assignee_name, total_applications
  FROM assignee_app_counts
  ORDER BY total_applications DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
yearly_by_assignee AS (
  SELECT
    ca.assignee_name,
    ca.pub_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.application_number) AS apps_in_year
  FROM cpc_apps ca
  WHERE ca.assignee_name IS NOT NULL AND ca.pub_year IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ca.assignee_name, ca.pub_year
),
best_year_per_assignee AS (
  SELECT
    y.assignee_name,
    y.pub_year AS best_year,
    y.apps_in_year
  FROM yearly_by_assignee y
  JOIN (
    SELECT assignee_name, MAX(apps_in_year) AS max_apps
    FROM yearly_by_assignee
    GROUP BY assignee_name
  ) m ON y.assignee_name = m.assignee_name AND y.apps_in_year = m.max_apps
),
country_by_assignee_year AS (
  SELECT
    ca.assignee_name,
    ca.pub_year,
    ca.country_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.application_number) AS apps_in_year_country
  FROM cpc_apps ca
  WHERE ca.assignee_name IS NOT NULL AND ca.pub_year IS NOT NULL AND ca.country_code IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ca.assignee_name, ca.pub_year, ca.country_code
),
best_country_per_assignee_year AS (
  SELECT
    c.assignee_name,
    c.pub_year,
    c.country_code AS top_country,

  JOIN (
    SELECT assignee_name, pub_year, MAX(apps_in_year_country) AS max_apps_country
    FROM country_by_assignee_year
    GROUP BY assignee_name, pub_year
  ) m ON c.assignee_name = m.assignee_name AND c.pub_year = m.pub_year AND c.apps_in_year_country = m.max_apps_country
)
SELECT
  t.assignee_name AS "assignee_name",
  t.total_applications AS "total_applications",
  b.best_year AS "year_with_most_applications",

WITH months AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_FROM_PARTS(y, m, 1)) AS month_start
  FROM (
    SELECT seq4() AS n
    FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 1))
  ) g,
  LATERAL (
    SELECT
      2008 + (n / 12) AS y,
      1 + (n % 12) AS m
    FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => (2022-2008+1)*12))
  )
),
pubs AS (
  SELECT
    TO_DATE(TO_VARCHAR("filing_date")) AS filing_date_iso,
    "publication_number",
    "abstract_localized"
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
  WHERE "country_code" = 'US'
    AND "filing_date" IS NOT NULL
),
abstracts AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    filing_date_iso,
    -- abstract_localized can be VARIANT: handle as string if scalar or extract text from first element
    CASE
      WHEN TRY_TO_VARCHAR(abstract_localized) IS NOT NULL THEN LOWER(TRY_TO_VARCHAR(abstract_localized))
      WHEN abstract_localized IS NOT NULL THEN LOWER(TO_VARCHAR(abstract_localized))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS abstract_text
  FROM pubs
),
iot_pubs AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    filing_date_iso,
    abstract_text
  FROM abstracts
  WHERE abstract_text LIKE '%internet of things%'
)
SELECT
  m.month_start AS month,
  COALESCE(COUNT(p.publication_number), 0) AS filings_count
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN iot_pubs p
  ON DATE_TRUNC('month', p.filing_date_iso) = m.month_start
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start
